fields.description: Stable machine key used by the review API, e.g. approved, rejected, more_info_required.

fields.description: Reviewer-facing label shown in the final judgement form.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: How a judgement with this status is treated: Approve completes review positively, Reject completes it negatively, Request More Info returns the case to the vendor, Other is neutral.

Approve
Reject
Request More Info
Other

fields.description: Display order in the judgement form; lower numbers appear first.
fields.label: Sort Order

fields.description: Only enabled statuses are offered by the review API and accepted on submission.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: A new organization's validation starts here when it has no payer validation status yet.
fields.label: Start Status

fields.description: A comment is mandatory when a reviewer selects this status.
fields.label: Requires Comment

fields.description: Reviewer guidance shown next to the status in the judgement form.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: The workflow: which statuses may follow this one. An organization's payer validation status can only move to one of these next statuses. Leave empty to make this a terminal status.
